decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (SH1 (Issue B), SH2 (Issue B) & SH4 (Issue B); received 20/09/2018. SH3 (Issue B1); received 02/11/2018) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the side or rear walls of the building hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The outbuilding hereby approved shall not be used for purposes other than those specified on the plans hereby approved or other such uses which are incidental to the application property, for the avoidance of doubt the building shall not be used as a living room, bedroom, kitchen or as a separate unit of accommodation.
description: Erection of an outbuilding to rear garden
